trigger: command classify (review ledger round.mjs, ticket board-doc-edit-viewer-esc/U2)

steps.text: classify it: record the defect with --class, --introduced and --caught, or classify one already recorded (classify <defect-id>); a class declared nowhere is declared once first, as the property class <name> of defect (lexicon propose define defect)
steps.leaves: the defect's or the classification's id

steps.text: name what let the bug be written (the state a value can hold that it never should, or a second way to do what one function should do alone), then sweep the codebase for every sibling of that shape and record the sweep: what was searched and each sibling found, or that it found none
steps.leaves: the representable shape, and the sweep

steps.text: fix it so the code cannot express it again, in preference to a check at the site: one door every caller must pass (a function or class its module keeps private, so the compiler, or a totality oracle where the language has no such check, refuses any other caller), a type that cannot hold the bad value, a walk with a stack of its own rather than recursion over what input controls, a fact derived where it is needed rather than kept twice; route every sibling the sweep found through it. When the dead-end reading names the defect's component (DEAD END in spec --check, Dead ends in orient), weigh a different design for that component before adding any such door to the one it has, and record the choice, redesign or keep, as a decision
steps.leaves: the door, type or derivation, and the siblings now routed through it; at a dead end, the decision choosing the design

steps.text: guard or decide: name an invariant that fails on any second way to write the bug, a chokepoint the compiler grades or a totality oracle that reads the code and refuses each other door (another call, a name held under an alias, a module asked for by string), adding the bullet when none exists; or record a decision saying why fixing the instance suffices, or that only time or a scheduler can show the bug (a cost, a race), bounding it structurally all the same (a size every read passes, a lock only one process can take)
steps.leaves: the guard's <component folder>/<invariant> or the decision's id

steps.text: refute the guard: witness a refutation of it, staging a second way to write the bug rather than replaying the instance
record the close: resolved <defect-id> --because "<what fixed it, and the sweep>" with --guard <component folder>/<invariant> or --decision <id>, then run spec --check
steps.leaves: the resolution's id; spec --check names no close with neither
